scopeNote.zh: 页码为从1开始的PDF物理页。20份完整原件共746页，本轮实际测试134个不重复页；6份全文、14份选页。18份处理完成、1份部分完成、1份能力不支持；这不是20份翻译质量全部合格。所有原件SHA-256保持不变。
scopeNote.en: Page numbers are 1-based physical PDF pages. The 20 originals contain 746 pages; 134 unique pages were tested: six full documents and selected pages from 14 others. Processing completed for 18, one was partial, and one was unsupported. This is not a claim that all 20 passed translation-quality review. All original SHA-256 hashes were unchanged.

reviewNote.zh: 结论来自修复后的真实输出、原生渲染与视觉记录。全文处理不等于逐字审校：部分长文仅做全页总览与指定页原尺寸抽查，具体范围列于每例visualReview。公开原件链接可能随后更新，页数和结论对应本次留存原件。
reviewNote.en: Findings come from final repaired outputs, native renders and visual records. Full-document processing is not word-by-word review: some long documents received overview checks plus full-size inspection of selected pages, listed in each visualReview. Public source files may later change; page counts and findings refer to the tested snapshots.

complete.zh: 处理完成（仍有质量限制）
